To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
miR-199a reveals two novel proteins E2F and EMR2 as oncogenic factors in lung cancer.
miR-199a represses the expression of two novel oncogenic targets E2F and EMR2 in lung cancer cells.
miR-99 expression decreases the proliferation and the CSC population in lung cancer cells by directly repressing the expression of the oncogenes E2F2, EMR2, vimentin and β-catenin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of new molecular targets in lung cancer, and miR-99 is one of the microRNA families that could be considered for therapeutic approaches in lung tumour patients.
the identification and characterisation of new molecular targets in lung cancer, which could be exploited for the development of novel therapeutic strategies.
the identification of new molecular targets that could be used in the development of therapeutic strategies for lung cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
miR- 99a is a tumour suppressor miRNA in lung cancer and that it is able to repress stemness and tumourigenesis by directly targeting E2F2, EMR2 and β-catenin.

miR- 99a is a tumour suppressor miRNA that inhibits EMT and CSC properties in lung cancer.
